einzeiler: Tax policy expert Ray Madoff on wealth, taxes, and capitalism.
kurzfassung: Ray Madoff discusses her career path from a Wall Street tax lawyer to a law professor and tax-policy expert. The conversation examines the mechanics of wealth accumulation, estate taxes, and economic inequality in America. She explains how the current tax system impacts capitalism and distinguishes between high earners and wealth holders.
stichpunkte: Career transition from philosophy and Wall Street to law professor and tax expert
America's return to a pre-revolutionary aristocracy and the accumulation of ultrawealth
Discrepancy between massive wealth generation and low estate tax yields
The distinction between high earners and wealth holders
How fair taxation could rescue capitalism and systemic tax policy issues
beschreibung:
Ray Madoff (The Second Estate, Immortality and the Law, Practical Guide to Estate Planning) is a Boston College law professor, author, and tax-policy expert. Ray joins Armchair Expert to discuss being a proudly mediocre high school student, reluctantly trading philosophy for law school, and becoming a terrible Wall Street tax lawyer who loved teaching. Ray and Dax talk about America’s return to a pre-revolutionary aristocracy, how “salaries are for suckers” among the ultrawealthy, and why $50 trillion in wealth yielded only $28 billion in estate tax. Ray explains why high earners and wealth holders aren’t the same, how fair taxation could rescue capitalism, and why the problem is the system and not billionaires themselves.
